# Saturn.Thrifttt — Cosmic Vintage Archive (India)

> Curated 1-of-1 archival streetwear, single-stitch band tees, American workwear jackets, and vintage denim sourced globally and delivered pan-India.

## About the Store
Saturn.Thrifttt (saturnthrifttt.com) is an indie vintage and archival streetwear archive based in Arera Colony, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India. Every piece is an authentic 1-of-1 historical relic sourced from Tokyo, Detroit, Valencia, and Milan. All garments undergo 0.5-inch precision measurements and medical-grade solar ozone sterilization before shipping.

## Core Offerings & Categories
- **Graphic Band Tees (1974–1996)**: Authentic single-stitch tees on Brockum, Murina, Giant, and Winterland tags (e.g. Pink Floyd Division Bell 1994, Soundgarden Superunknown 1994). Pricing: ₹2,499 – ₹5,999 INR.
- **Work Jackets (1982–1999)**: Heavyweight canvas jackets with corduroy collars and blanket linings (e.g. Carhartt Detroit Duck Jacket, Santa Fe Aztec Bomber). Pricing: ₹4,999 – ₹9,999 INR.
- **Archival Denim (1978–1995)**: Valencia 555 stamped button Levi's 501 Orange Tab and broken-twill Wrangler 13MWZ. Pricing: ₹3,499 – ₹7,999 INR.
- **Knitwear & Vests (1990–1999)**: Chunky rib-knit and jacquard weave collector gems (Stüssy, Issey). Pricing: ₹3,999 – ₹6,499 INR.
- **Heavy Hoodies (1989–1998)**: Heavyweight 450 GSM reverse-weave fleece (Champion, Russell Athletic). Pricing: ₹4,299 – ₹6,999 INR.

## Payment & Delivery Protocols (India Only)
- **Instant UPI (YouPI-PG Sovereign Rail)**: 0% gateway commission, instant direct bank settlement via Kotak Bank (`9329993116@kotakbank`), Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, and CRED.
- **Pan-India Delivery Charges**: Standard delivery fee of ₹120. First delivery is complimentary (FREE) for all first-time collectors.

## Logistics & Sustainable Packaging
- Dispatched across India via express air-freight (2–4 business days delivery).
- Shipped in 100% post-consumer reinforced kraft tube packaging. Every acquisition includes a complimentary collectible cosmic trading card.
